original_test_intent: Validate the single TEMP_UBB_IBC temperature channel for the owner-defined IBC component and power domain, including any legitimate GPU association, with consistent identity, reading and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The board/power owner expands IBC, identifies its device, location, served rail/load and sensor source, and states whether AMDGPU is relevant; automation then performs secret-safe passive cross-path collection without executing the parenthesized annotation.
manual_activity: The board/power owner defines IBC, maps the sensor to its physical component and served load, confirms or rejects the AMDGPU association, and approves operating-condition limits and Web evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative IBC expansion, function, part/revision and UBB physical location
IBC input/output rail, served load/GPU domain and operating-mode mapping
Sensor source as die, package, board probe or derived telemetry
Decision and identity mapping for any AMDGPU association
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, resolution, tolerance, freshness and unavailable semantics
Ranges/thresholds by rail voltage, load, power mode, cooling and ambient
Same-target IB/OOB identity, revisions, secret-safe collectors and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1878 and never use the duplicate TEMP_SW_VR workflow
Do not infer IBC expansion or GPU association from the name or annotation
Do not append `(AMDGPU)` to a shell pipeline
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web evidence
Do not change IBC rails/load, reload drivers, start workload, alter fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on identity ambiguity, rail/power anomaly, stale/invalid value, unsafe temperature or cross-path disagreement; no retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, duplicate isolation and owner-approved IBC identity
Record passive IBC rail/load and any GPU identity without state changes
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact TEMP_UBB_IBC and Web evidence
Compare identity/value/state/freshness with passive power/GPU/fan/SEL context
Perform no acronym inference, annotation execution, control action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define IBC and its device, power-domain/load and measurement source
Approve or reject AMDGPU association and provide any stable mapping
Review cross-path evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact sensor read is only partial: it lacks IB, complete Sensor List and Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials; it also cannot resolve IBC or AMDGPU semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After identity approval, collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, exact IBC data, Web parity and passive power-domain context without changing load.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES IBC COMPONENT, POWER-DOMAIN AND THERMAL-CRITERIA PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the exact sensor to an IBC device/rail/load and sensing point, then capture synchronized management views with input/output power and cooling context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the acronym and electrical load context that determine whether the temperature and limit are meaningful.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The same-code switch-VR Web row and an unverified AMDGPU association provide no IBC acceptance coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If IBC is a power converter, dissipation changes nonlinearly with load and conversion efficiency; a value under an unknown rail state cannot be compared safely to a single generic limit.

project_override_considerations: If IBC means something other than an intermediate bus converter, the owner-provided definition governs. If the sensor aggregates multiple devices, an explicit coverage and worst-case rule is required.
expected_evidence: Approved IBC expansion, component/location and rail/load diagram
Sensor-source and any AMDGPU identity relationship
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact sensor result
Reading/state/unit/freshness with input/output power, load, cooling, ambient and limits
BMC Web evidence and passive GPU/power/fan/SEL context
Same-target proof, status, hashes and annotation-handling audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1878 consistently requests TEMP_UBB_IBC across management views. IBC and AMDGPU semantics are undefined inputs, while the code collision is isolated by row identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive single-sensor verification is identifiable after the owner supplies component and power-domain semantics under ED-36.

review_improvement: Separates the switch-VR duplicate, requires an authoritative IBC and electrical-load identity, and prevents an unexplained AMDGPU annotation from becoming executable or evidentiary fact.
independent_technical_reasoning: Thermal acceptance for a power-domain component depends on which rail and load it serves, because dissipation and local airflow determine its temperature. Without that electrical identity, a numerically plausible TEMP_UBB_IBC value can neither prove the correct sensor nor the correct operating envelope.
